failure_type: late detection (short sensing range) + sensor noise + unlucky planner randomness
explanation: The UAV collided with an obstacle at 3.2 seconds due to a combination of limited sensing range and sensor noise, both of which prevented failure when adjusted in counterfactual simulations. Additionally, the flight was sensitive to planner randomness, as re-seeding the RRT algorithm successfully prevented the collision. The short 0.6-second window between detection and the closest approach further limited the UAV's ability to react effectively.
